basis: The state prevalence dashboard (Incidence of Condition A in US States) uses a color scale where dark red/maroon indicates the lowest values (0) and light yellow indicates the highest values (100). Among the three candidate states, New Hampshire (NH) is colored light yellow, indicating the highest prevalence (near 100). Florida (FL) is dark maroon (lowest, near 0), and Delaware (DE) is a medium orange (mid-range). Therefore, NH has the highest prevalence and should be routed to the priority follow-up workflow.
option_label: Open New Hampshire (NH) statistics view for priority follow-up
